wizardSpecs.cellOfOtherHeader: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} lies in cell ({{cx}}, {{cy}}) of header {{owner}}, not of {{outside}}: there the game does not take the warps of {{outside}}.
wizardSpecs.cellWithoutMap: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} lies in cell ({{cx}}, {{cy}}) without a map.
wizardSpecs.chooseOutsideArea: Choose the area at the entrance.
wizardSpecs.connects: Connects {{from}} (tile x {{x}}, z {{z}}) with the new room.
wizardSpecs.connectWorldTinker: Connect to the world: {{setDoor}} (choose the target in the event editor)
wizardSpecs.doesNotFire: Caution: on the {{sides}} tile a warp does not fire in the game (no door or warp tile).
wizardSpecs.doorBack: Door B leads back to door A.
wizardSpecs.doorEndTile: Door {{name}}: door tile set on map {{map}}, tile x {{x}}, z {{z}}
wizardSpecs.doorStays: Door B keeps leading where it led.
wizardSpecs.doorTileSet: Door tile set: map {{map}}, tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} within the map.
wizardSpecs.enterOutsideTile: Enter the tile of the outside door (x and z).
wizardSpecs.entrance: Entrance: warp {{outside}} {{where}}, way back: warp {{inside}} in the new room.
wizardSpecs.entranceReused: Entrance: warp {{outside}} {{where}}, way back: warp {{inside}} (the copied warp on the tile, switched over) in the new room.
wizardSpecs.furnish: Furnish the interior: characters, triggers and signs with the tools or “+” in “In this scene”
wizardSpecs.furnishTinker: Furnish the interior: edit the map in the grid tab
wizardSpecs.insideOffMap: The tile lies outside the map (0 to {{max}}).
wizardSpecs.inUse_one: Caution: header {{id}} is in use ({{count}} warp leads here); it loses its current grid {{matrix}}.
wizardSpecs.inUse_other: Caution: header {{id}} is in use ({{count}} warps lead here); it loses its current grid {{matrix}}.
wizardSpecs.lookAtArea: Look at it: “Show” opens the new area
wizardSpecs.makesDoor: Makes the {{sides}} tile a door (behavior 0x69, collision 0x80); otherwise the warp does not fire in the game.
wizardSpecs.nameEmpty: The name must not be empty.
wizardSpecs.newEvents: A new, empty list of characters and doors.
wizardSpecs.noEntranceBuild: Creates no entrance{{why}}: set one later with {{setDoor}}.
wizardSpecs.noEntranceTinker: Creates no entrance{{why}}: set the {{warp}} later in the header editor under “{{warps}}”.
wizardSpecs.objectInScript: Object {{object}} in event file {{file}}, battle script {{script}}
wizardSpecs.offOutsideArea: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} lies outside the area at the entrance (x 0 to {{maxX}}, z 0 to {{maxZ}}).
wizardSpecs.offRaster: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} lies outside the grid (x 0 to {{maxX}}, z 0 to {{maxZ}}).
wizardSpecs.outsideIsRoom: The area at the entrance must not be the new room.
wizardSpecs.outsideIsRoomHeader: The outside header must not be the header of the new room.
wizardSpecs.patchedBuild: Game code adapted for new places (stays).
wizardSpecs.pickTarget: Choose the cell where the area should lie on the world map.
wizardSpecs.placeNameEmpty: The name of the new place must not be empty.
wizardSpecs.rasterSummaryWithHeaders: Creates grid “{{name}}” ({{width}} × {{height}}) with a header section.
wizardSpecs.reused: The copied warp {{index}} on this tile becomes the way back; no second one is added.
wizardSpecs.reusedTarget: The copied warp {{index}} on this tile (until now targeting header {{target}}) becomes the way back; no second one is added.
wizardSpecs.roomSummaryBuild: Creates the room “{{name}}” with a copy of map {{map}}, {{buildings}}.
wizardSpecs.roomSummaryTinker: Creates grid “{{name}}” with a copy of map {{map}}, {{buildings}}.
wizardSpecs.seamless: Walkable without seams: walk over from the neighbouring area.
wizardSpecs.seamlessIn: Walkable without seams: walk over from the neighbouring area in grid {{matrix}}.
wizardSpecs.setDoor: the tool “Door” or “+” › “Door” in “In this scene”

special.default: default header of every cell without one of its own
special.underground: Underground: the game starts the Underground there, a room stays black
special.union: Union Room, reachable only by script

wizardSpecs.specialLine: Caution: header {{id}} is a special header ({{why}}).
wizardSpecs.takenInside: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} inside already has warp {{index}} of event file {{file}}, which the room keeps: choose another tile or “Copy of …”.
wizardSpecs.takenOutside: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} outside already has warp {{index}}: choose another tile.
wizardSpecs.takenOutsideTarget: Tile x {{x}}, z {{z}} outside already has warp {{index}} (target header {{target}}): choose another tile.
wizardSpecs.targetBuild: Lies on the world map {{name}} at x {{x}}, y {{y}} (walkable without seams){{replaced}}.
wizardSpecs.targetTinker_one: Target: grid {{matrix}}, cell {{x}}, {{y}}; {{count}} landscape cell is replaced.
wizardSpecs.targetTinker_other: Target: grid {{matrix}}, cell {{x}}, {{y}}; {{count}} landscape cells are replaced.
wizardSpecs.tryDoor: Try it: save, build and walk through the door
wizardSpecs.tryFigure: Try it: save, build and talk to the character
wizardSpecs.tryRoom: Try it: save, build and walk in and back out in the emulator
wizardSpecs.tryTrainer: Try it: save, build and walk into the trainer's line of sight
wizardSpecs.wayBack: The way back lies in the new room on tile x {{x}}, z {{z}}.
